_about: Objects (by name, regexes) KEPT in a build's export although an exporter ground rule would leave them out: real storeys, podiums, steps, terraces and walls that only share a word (street_, plaza_, site_, paving, ground) with the lot. slug -> [regex, ...], or {objects: [...], materials: {old: new}} to map a whole-dropped ground material (rig_ground) to a building material. Run through scripts/v2/blender_export_keep.py, so the exporter itself, and every other build's export, stay as they were. Found by the 2026-10-31 audit of dropped parts.
